dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Oman-mediated safe-passage work remains the latest authoritative Hormuz development. Post-09Z reporting added pause/air-defence commentary and Caspian analysis, not a new strike on Iran, tanker boarding, mining event or zero-traffic confirmation. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Lebanon's army said Israeli forces were continuing bombardment, automatic-weapons sweeps, destruction and fire near army positions in several southern areas, obstructing deployment under the U.S.-sponsored framework. This newly reactivates ceasefire_violation while diplomacy_active remains in force. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 87-lane Google review, 20 Bing tracker lanes and direct checks produced no verified Turkish combat entry, regional force movement, official nuclear-doctrine shift or missile-range test. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The full review produced no fresh India-Pakistan interstate strike, Line of Control exchange or Indian force movement. Pakistan-administered Kashmir unrest remains internal rather than a new interstate threshold. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified post-09Z border strike, crossing closure or sustained interstate clash surfaced. Militant violence inside Pakistan and older Afghan airstrike coverage do not establish a new state-on-state threshold. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Battlefield strikes and the Ukraine-linked Caspian vessel attack remain active escalation evidence. Post-09Z coverage added casualty reporting and rhetoric around the Iranian vessels, but no direct NATO combat entry or new Russian nuclear-posture change. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania's Defence Ministry confirmed an F-16 shot down a third unauthorized drone in three days, 12 km northeast of Sulina in Romanian territorial waters. President Nicușor Dan blamed Russia and called the NATO-airspace violations intolerable; the foreign ministry summoned Russia's ambassador. No casualty or Article 4/5 action was reported. Raw 56; coupled 66

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new PLA quarantine, Taiwan blockade declaration, amphibious concentration or cross-Strait clash surfaced. The U.S.-Japan-Philippines exercise remains scored only under south_china_sea. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: The allegation that Russia seeks 30,000 additional North Korean troops gained more syndication but no independent confirmation. No DPRK launch or nuclear test surfaced. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh DW reporting described civilians used as human shields, reinforcing the severity of the existing war but not establishing a new strategic capture, direct external-force entry or distinct Port Sudan event. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The National reported a fresh single-day West Bank escalation: settlers torched two mosques, attacked homes and workers, while Israeli forces conducted arrests, closures and land seizures. dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or Abyei security shift surfaced across the exact and fallback lanes. Raw 19; coupled 19
